scout.name: Scout
scout.desc: Fast and stealthy. Ideal for scouting and countering Fighters.

fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.desc: Versatile combat ship. Ideal as the backbone of any fleet.

cruiser.name: Cruiser
cruiser.desc: Heavy defense. Protects smaller ships in the fleet.

carrier.name: Carrier
carrier.desc: Strategic ship. Launches fighter squadrons into battle.

special.name: Flagship
special.desc: Command ship of the fleet. Provides a bonus to all ships.

Kinetic.name: Kinetic
Kinetic.desc: Physical damage. High DPS, no special effect.

Heat.name: Heat
Heat.desc: Thermal damage. Burning effect — damage over X rounds.

Magnetic.name: Magnetic
Magnetic.desc: EMP damage. Chance to stun or disable weapons/engine.

Explosive.name: Explosive
Explosive.desc: Area damage. Hits multiple ships at once.

Mixed.name: Mixed
Mixed.desc: Combined damage. Elite Fighter Bay units.

Ballistic.name: Ballistic
Ballistic.desc: Direct fire. Highest DPS, short range.

Directional.name: Directional
Directional.desc: Directed beam. Medium DPS, medium range, +10% crit.

Missile.name: Missile
Missile.desc: Guided missile. Never misses. Long range.

FighterBay.name: Fighter Bay
FighterBay.desc: Launches fighter craft. Carriers and Flagships only. Multi-target.
